---
name: Documentation
about: A doc is missing, unclear, or incorrect
title: "[Docs] "

---

## Problem

Which file/section is affected? What's wrong or missing?

## Context

Why does this matter for a reader (student, contributor, facilitator)?

## Expected behavior

What should the doc say or include instead?

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The change is accurate.
- [ ] The change is beginner-friendly.
- [ ] No unrelated content changed.
